Q: Space between items in bootstrap A:

In bootstrap4 you can use g-* (change number instead *) class in row container. It will add grid gutter space. And If you switch to bootstrap5 there is a gap-* class you can use.

Q: How to change border color of NSScrollView? A:

To get a working border around a NSScrollView object, you must create the border around the contentView property of the scroll view. Example:

scrollView.contentView.wantsLayer = true
scrollView.contentView.layer?.borderWidth = 0.5
scrollView.contentView.layer?.borderColor = NSColor.red.cgColor
